
```{r}
collisions_file_path <- "https://data.dft.gov.uk/road-accidents-safety-data/dft-road-casualty-statistics-collision-last-5-years.csv"
casualties_file_path <- "https://data.dft.gov.uk/road-accidents-safety-data/dft-road-casualty-statistics-casualty-last-5-years.csv"
vehicles_file_path <- "https://data.dft.gov.uk/road-accidents-safety-data/dft-road-casualty-statistics-vehicle-last-5-years.csv"

# download the data files from the specified URLs
download.file(collisions_file_path, "collisions.csv")
download.file(casualties_file_path, "casualties.csv")
download.file(vehicles_file_path, "vehicles.csv")

```
